title: The Boring Company Information Session
summary: A long information session where The Boring Company presents its vision for Loop, an underground high-speed transit system, and the traffic problems it aims to solve. It includes discussion of faster tunnel boring and electrification.
why: HN commenters point to it as the primary source for what the company is actually proposing, in threads skeptical of the project.

quote.text: It's worth watching to see what they are proposing.
